name: Spectral Archers
disable: DC 31 Intimidation check (expert) to cow the archers into fleeing or DC 28 Religion check (expert) to temporarily banish the spirits
reset: The haunt vanishes permanently if the graveknights are destroyed. Otherwise, it returns after 1 hour.

items.name: Rain of Bolts
items.text:
Trigger A creature attacks the graveknights in area G1 or enters the castle

---
Effect The haunt makes a spectral bolt Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

items.name: Routine
items.text: (1 action) The hazard fires one bolt at every creature in a 30-foot-by-30-foot area in front of the gate as 1 action. Because the spectral archers fire bolts continuously, the haunt can also use the Continuous Barrage free action (below) to fire bolts at each creature during that creature's turn.

items.name: Continuous Barrage
items.text:
Trigger A creature in front of the gate finishes an action

---
Effect The haunt makes a spectral bolt Strike against the triggering creature.

text: Ghostly soldiers wielding crossbows manifest within the towers that flank the gatehouse and rain bolts down upon intruders.
